assets.title: Floor-Standing Document Copier
assets.description: Original generic floor-standing copier with four bearing feet, a real open output recess and supported collection tray, separate scanner cover and feeder silhouette, two fixed cassette fronts with modeled blind grip recesses, and a tilted opaque control screen. Twenty editable closed parts in one static closed-service pose. Self-contained QA checks an external A4 rectangular fixture on the actual tray, an overwide fixture and a disconnected-tray negative. Old organizing table and storage cabinet are adjacent context only. No printing, scanning, paper-feed, electrical-safety or continuous mechanism simulation.
